note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Only the focus tag's reference is substituted; its line follows the row carrying that reference, or is not redrawn when none does (as supplied). No validity, responsibility or outcome is inferred. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels (+ focusItem).
